I checked the account's ticket folder in the shared files and found nothing, and I checked #central-team, the working channel you're in, which has no mention of it. Your #central-team thread about Marrow Agrisupply's store rollout (PD-4821 is the only ticket number in it, for Eastbank's receiving-door import) is a different account and issue, so I haven't treated it as a match.

Two things would help. Is the ticket under Marrow Agrisupply rather than Fieldworks? Or does someone on the account team have the number? Once you have it, or if you tell me where it was logged, I can look again before your customer call.
